title: A resolution recognizing the 1960 University of Missouri Tigers Football Team for its undefeated regular season, Orange Bowl victory, and claim to the 1960 National Championship.
latestAction: Submitted in the Senate, considered, and agreed to without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent.
